title: Listening Comes First
caption:
Every session I do begins the same way.
Not with a brush, but with a conversation.

What do you wear on an ordinary day?
What do you like about your face?
Where do you hesitate in front of the mirror?

As I listen, a picture slowly forms.
Not of a trend, or of someone else,
but of what already suits you.

The technique comes after that.
It matters, of course.
But the most useful tool I bring
may be the time I spend listening first.
